e.title: Auto Insurance Data Tools
e.summary: 州保险署车险费率数据采集与分析开源工具：各州 DOI 网站费率数据收集
e.body: Auto Insurance Data Tools 是从各州保险署（Department of Insurance）网站采集与分析车险费率数据的开源工具（含在线站点）：费率文件、费率手册数据的自动化收集。对 RIAA：车险市场费率数据的采集工具（监管公开数据的工程化获取）。与 [[gip125-auto-loss-cost]]（SOA 损失成本）、保险数据主题、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互补。关联 [[insurancerating]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
e.verified_note: raw README 核实：各州 DOI 车险费率数据采集分析工具（含在线站点）
e.summary_en: Open-source tools for collecting and analysing auto-insurance rate data from state Department of Insurance websites
e.summary_hk: 州保險署車險費率數據採集與分析開源工具：各州 DOI 網站費率數據收集
e.body_en: Auto Insurance Data Tools is an open-source toolkit (with a live site) for collecting and analysing auto-insurance rate data directly from state Department of Insurance websites: automated collection of rate filings and rate-manual data. For RIAA: a data-collection tool for auto-market rate data (engineering access to public regulatory data). Complements [[gip125-auto-loss-cost]] (SOA loss cost), the insurance-data theme and [[actuarial-pricing]]. Related: [[insurancerating]], [[insurance-governance]].
e.body_hk: Auto Insurance Data Tools 是從各州保險署（Department of Insurance）網站採集與分析車險費率數據的開源工具（含在線站點）：費率文件、費率手冊數據的自動化收集。對 RIAA：車險市場費率數據的採集工具（監管公開數據的工程化獲取）。與 [[gip125-auto-loss-cost]]（SOA 損失成本）、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互補。關聯 [[insurancerating]]、[[insurance-governance]]。
